categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Touches `src/index/txindex.cpp` to check iterator status and report database read failures in `TxIndex::FindTx()`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a data integrity bug where `TxIndex::FindTx()` silently returns `std::nullopt` instead of throwing an error when encountering LevelDB read errors or database corruption. In the indexes category, returning wrong answers on corruption is treated as a priority data integrity concern.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Although `src/dbwrapper.{h,cpp}` are touched to expose `CheckStatus()`, the change is purely an index-driven helper addition that does not substantively alter validation logic or chainstate invariants.
categories.rationale: Does not alter validation behavior; changes to `src/dbwrapper` exist solely to support `TxIndex` error reporting.
